about.title: Your freedom to fly.
about.intro: Air Spain is a project born to offer the freedom so many of us want in the exciting world of virtual aviation.
points: From anywhere to anywhere, with any aircraft — offline, on VATSIM or on IVAO.
Plan weights and fuel, nail your landings and make every flight profitable. Economics is the heart of an airline.
This company is shaped by its members' ideas, interests and knowledge, so everyone can enjoy it.

normative.title: How we fly.
rules: Air Spain is a virtual airline that emulates a hypothetical airline through flight simulation. Every member can create routes or use existing ones with any origin, destination and aircraft.
Our flights use the callsign XSNXXXX "Air Spain" for communications.
Fly IFR or VFR, online or offline — total freedom. When connected to a network, follow its rules of conduct and courtesy.
Members flying on VATSIM can file their flight plan directly from our system.
Each route is planned for the selected aircraft only, with passenger, cargo and fuel data. To fly it with a different aircraft, create a new route with the matching data.
Flights are tracked and reported with the free ACARS program, available in our downloads area.
Members' personal data is private, for internal use and communication purposes only, in line with Spanish data protection law.
Any member can leave by contacting an administrator at info@air-spain.es. It takes effect immediately.
